description: A soaking tub hewn from a single monolithic block of the same grey stone as the walls, deep and wide enough to lie down in and disappear. It fills from a slot in the rim with no visible tap; the water sheets in silent and steaming. Set against the glass wall, it faces the whole bay: a bath with a hundred-mile view and nothing in the world able to look back in.
name: monolithic soaking tub
